The course is an introduction to visual representation of information taught by Alberto Cairo and involves creating infographics using charts, maps, diagrams and illustrations. It will include lectures, exercises and three projects. Students will learn about effective graphical displays, storytelling with visuals and principles of information design. The course requires a substantial time commitment outside of class. Grading will be based on a quiz, exercises and three projects.
